description: Create monster/js_analyzer.py (~2500 lines) and monster/vuln_scanner.py (~3000 lines) - the two largest analysis/scanning modules.
steps: Create monster/js_analyzer.py (~2500 lines) with: JSResults dataclass, COMMON_JS_PATHS list (30+ paths), JSAnalyzer class with: (1) discover_js_files - fetch HTML and parse script tags, check common paths, find .map files, (2) download_js - download JS content with size limit, (3) beautify_js - basic JavaScript beautifier that adds newlines/indentation to minified code (regex-based, not full parser), (4) extract_endpoints - find API paths, URLs, fetch/axios/XHR calls with comprehensive regex, (5) detect_secrets - use 50+ regex patterns from config to find leaked keys/tokens/credentials, (6) detect_dependencies - identify npm packages and library versions from JS code patterns, (7) detect_dom_sinks - find innerHTML, document.write, eval, setTimeout with string, Function constructor, postMessage listeners, (8) detect_prototype_pollution - find patterns like obj[key] = value, Object.assign with user input, deep merge functions, (9) detect_jsonp_endpoints - find callback= patterns and JSONP-style responses, (10) analyze_postmessage - find postMessage calls and message event listeners, check origin validation, (11) extract_storage_keys - find localStorage.setItem/getItem, sessionStorage operations, (12) analyze_service_workers - detect SW registration, find SW scope and cached routes, (13) discover_webpack_chunks - find webpackJsonp patterns, chunk loading URLs, manifest, (14) extract_graphql - find GraphQL queries/mutations/subscriptions in JS, (15) extract_websocket_urls - find ws:// and wss:// URLs, (16) detect_debug_info - find console.log with sensitive data, source map references, dev comments, (17) run() method that orchestrates all analysis for all targets, saves results. Follow pattern of returning JSResults objects.

Create monster/vuln_scanner.py (~3000 lines) with: Finding dataclass (finding_type, severity, title, description, url, evidence, remediation, cvss_score, cwe_id, to_dict method), VulnScanner class with: (1) check_security_headers - check all SECURITY_HEADERS, report missing/misconfigured, (2) check_cors - test with evil.com, null origin, prefix match, suffix match, subdomain, special chars in origin, wildcard with credentials, (3) check_cookie_security - check HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite/Path/Expiry for all cookies, (4) check_clickjacking - check X-Frame-Options and CSP frame-ancestors, (5) check_information_disclosure - probe INFO_DISCLOSURE_PATHS for exposed files, (6) check_http_methods - test OPTIONS/TRACE/PUT/DELETE/PATCH, (7) check_host_header - test host header injection, (8) check_ssl_tls - check certificate validity/expiry/chain/weak ciphers, (9) check_email_security - check SPF/DKIM/DMARC records, (10) check_csp_weaknesses - parse CSP and check for unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval/wildcards/data:/blob:, (11) check_cache_poisoning - test unkeyed headers (X-Forwarded-Host, X-Original-URL, X-Rewrite-URL), (12) check_request_smuggling_indicators - check for CL.TE/TE.CL indicators, ambiguous content-length, (13) check_graphql_introspection - send introspection query and check if enabled, (14) check_ssrf_indicators - identify URL/file params that might be SSRF-prone, (15) check_xxe_indicators - check for XML content type acceptance, XML endpoints, (16) check_idor_patterns - detect sequential IDs, UUID patterns in URLs, (17) check_rate_limiting - send rapid requests and check for rate limit headers/responses, (18) check_waf_fingerprint - identify WAF using WAF_SIGNATURES from config, (19) check_403_bypass - try path normalization, header tricks (X-Original-URL, X-Rewrite-URL, X-Forwarded-For), URL encoding tricks, (20) check_broken_link_hijacking - check external links for dead domains, (21) check_business_logic - detect price params, quantity params, discount codes in URLs, (22) check_api_versioning - probe /v1, /v2, /v3, /api/v1, etc., (23) check_sensitive_files - expanded check using SENSITIVE_FILE_PATHS from config, (24) check_parameter_pollution - test HPP by duplicating params, (25) check_crlf_injection - test CRLF in headers via URL params, (26) check_path_traversal - test ../ patterns in file-related params, (27) check_open_redirect - test redirect params with external URLs, (28) check_subdomain_takeover - check CNAME records against TAKEOVER_FINGERPRINTS, (29) run() method that orchestrates all checks, saves findings. Each check creates Finding objects and appends to self.findings list.
Verify: python -c 'from monster.js_analyzer import JSAnalyzer, JSResults; print("JS analyzer OK")'
Verify: python -c 'from monster.vuln_scanner import VulnScanner, Finding; print("Vuln scanner OK")'
Verify: wc -l shows 2400+ for js_analyzer.py and 2800+ for vuln_scanner.py
acceptance_criteria: Both follow the existing patterns (HTTPClient, ColorOutput, FileManager)
